steps.what: Check shipment facts and required shipping document types and capture missing particulars
Prepare bills of lading, packing lists, dock receipts or origin certificate drafts
Verify shipping documents and complete the authorised issue or certification handover

tasks.design: Configure document templates in {OPS_SYSTEM} from the forwarder's checked shipment inputs. The forwarder checks the exact documents and handles authorised issue or certification; a populated origin certificate is a draft until the required authorised process is completed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same shipment facts may be retyped into several document layouts.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing transport systems support document creation from their shipment records.
tasks.still_hard: Contradictory instructions, unsupported origin claims and document-specific authority.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a formally complete document asserts an unproved fact.
tasks.altitude: Less document retyping where it remains; factual and issue responsibility stay with authorised people.

reach.task: Maintain a checked shipment document set with traceable revisions
reach.learn: Document purpose, source evidence and certification boundaries

evidence.claim: Qargo and TransFollow support creating and signing digital consignment notes inside a transport system; that supports native document reuse but does not establish authority to certify origin or this exact document set.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation and authorised handling of shipping documents, excluding customs forms, invoices and physical receipt or packing. Overlapping attachment preparation belongs to one task in a roll-up.

Before s1, the shipper supplies instructions, packing staff supply existing item/quantity/weight evidence, the receiving party supplies actual receipt evidence when applicable and the origin evidence owner supplies existing supporting records. These producer tasks are unchanged.

In s1 the forwarder checks and captures shipment ID, party names and addresses, goods descriptions, pieces, marks, quantities, weights/units, journey, document type, source references and document-specific facts such as receipt status or supported origin. All manual capture and clarification are counted.

Missing evidence stops the affected draft; planned receipt is not actual receipt and origin is never inferred from a dispatch address. Manual document preparation or authorised clarification is the fallback.

Test native templates before custom code. Existing generated documents earn no saving. Allow 7 focal hours per 100 baseline for template maintenance and generation faults; existing certification work remains unchanged.
unknowns: Current native generation and retyping effort
research_questions: Does native generation reduce work after document-specific evidence and revision checks?

already_counted.description: Document requirement checks and missing-field capture remain counted
Final document review and authorised issue or handover remain counted

incremental.description: Maintain templates and resolve generation faults

approvals.approved_version: Exact shipping document set, source snapshots, issue purpose and recipient or certification handover; changed facts or documents void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60; gross saving 40 less 7 upkeep gives net 33. Range 8-20 assumes manual multi-document retyping today and substantial evidence exceptions; existing native generation yields zero new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check customs instructions and supporting documents and capture the required form particulars
Complete customs paperwork drafts from the checked particulars and referenced evidence
Verify completed customs paperwork and pass the exact version for authorised processing

tasks.design: Use native form completion in {OTHER}, the customs documentation system, from checked and authorised particulars. The forwarder checks the exact paperwork before handing it over; software does not determine a new classification, valuation or origin conclusion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Checked facts and instructions may be re-entered into customs forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing customs software supports structured records and form preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Material missing facts, representation authority and inconsistencies between instructions and evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Identifying unsupported conclusions before they enter formal paperwork.
tasks.altitude: Less form transcription is possible while substantive customs judgement and authorised submission remain unchanged.

reach.task: Present completed forms with traceable supporting evidence
reach.learn: Form-field meaning and limits of preparation authority

evidence.claim: Boltrics provides forwarding and customs software, supporting examination of native form preparation without proving this exact field mapping or local saving.

assumptions: Boundary is completion and review of actual customs forms, excluding the separate task of arranging duties, taxes and clearance coordination. If the coordination pack already includes these forms, a roll-up assigns form completion once, not to both tasks.

The shipper supplies existing shipment evidence, the customer supplies representation authority and the authorised customs specialist supplies existing approved classification, valuation, origin and procedure instructions before s1.

In s1 the forwarder checks or captures shipment and party IDs, goods line IDs, quantities/units, instructed codes/procedure, value/currency, instructed origin, document references and instruction versions. All missing-field capture and clarification are counted in s1; no free structured customs dataset is assumed.

S2 only maps confirmed particulars into the required form fields. Missing instructions, unsupported origin or conflicting values require manual clarification and preparation; no model supplies a legal conclusion.

Test native form completion before custom integration. Existing automated forms earn no new saving. Allow 8 focal hours per 100 baseline for form/version upkeep and faults; existing specialist review and submission are unchanged.
research_questions: Does native completion save effort after supporting-evidence, instruction-version and field-meaning checks?

already_counted.description: Instruction checks and manual capture remain counted
Completed-form review and authorised handover remain counted

incremental.description: Maintain form mappings and resolve preparation faults

approvals.approved_version: Exact customs form set, supporting-document and instruction versions, shipment and handover recipient; any changed field or evidence voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70; gross saving 30 less 8 upkeep gives net 22. Range 3-12 assumes actual form retyping remains and many cases need manual clarification; coordination-pack overlap is assigned once.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check shipment charges, quotation scope or completed services and capture billing particulars
Prepare freight invoices or cost quotations from checked charge lines and document type
Review and issue the exact freight invoice or cost quotation within authority

tasks.design: Configure draft invoice and quotation generation in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {ERP} from checked charge lines. The forwarder checks scope, totals, tax treatment supplied by finance and the exact recipient before issue; negotiation and rate determination are outside this automation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Approved shipment charges may be copied and totalled again for customer documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native transport billing can generate documents from a shipment record.
tasks.still_hard: Unconfirmed extras, disputed services and distinguishing an estimate from a final invoice.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a mathematically correct document bills the wrong service or promises the wrong scope.
tasks.altitude: The forwarder may spend less time composing billing documents while retaining commercial review and issue responsibility.

reach.task: Resolve a charge-line discrepancy with shipment evidence
reach.learn: Billing controls, tax-field ownership and audit trail

evidence.claim: The digest's Mark Huisman Logistics vendor case reports invoicing effort falling from 10 hours weekly to 30 minutes after a Qargo rollout; this is context, not a transferable estimate for these tasks.

assumptions: Boundary is invoice/quotation preparation and authorised issue, excluding carrier negotiation, rate estimation, debt collection and finance's policy decisions.

The shipment process supplies existing service records, the pricing owner supplies approved rates/charge lines and finance supplies existing tax and billing rules before s1. The forwarder checks or captures customer/billing identity, shipment ID, document type, charge descriptions, quantities, unit prices, currency, tax code, terms, quote validity and source references in s1; all capture time stays counted.
For invoices, service completion evidence is required; for quotes, scope and validity replace completion evidence. These are workload alternatives, not both mandatory inputs for every document.

S2 performs only supplied line arithmetic and document formatting. Unconfirmed extras, unclear tax treatment or missing billing identity require manual clarification; no new rate or tax conclusion is generated.

Test native billing configuration before custom links. Existing generated documents earn no saving. Allow 8 focal hours per 100 baseline for mapping upkeep and document faults, plus 3 other-role hours for finance/interface maintenance.
unknowns: Current native billing and retyping effort
research_questions: Does native generation reduce effort after scope, extra-charge and final-document review?

already_counted.description: Billing input checks and missing-field capture remain counted
Final document review and issue remain counted

incremental.description: Maintain mappings and resolve document faults
Maintain finance rules and interface configuration

approvals.approved_version: Exact invoice or quotation, charge/source snapshot, document type, terms and customer recipient; any changed line, scope or recipient voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55; gross saving 45 less 8 focal upkeep gives net 37. Range 10-25 assumes repeated manual billing-document preparation today and significant extras and scope exceptions; the vendor case is not used as the central estimate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture cargo, transit-time and security needs and check carrier route alternatives
Prepare a comparison of checked shipment routes, transit times and stated constraints
Select the shipment route after judging cargo suitability, transit and security trade-offs

tasks.design: Configure a route-comparison view in {OPS_SYSTEM} from checked carrier alternatives and explicit customer requirements. The forwarder retains the choice and checks uncertain transfers or security conditions; the table does not certify route safety or guarantee transit time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparable route facts may be arranged manually before the choice.
tasks.enabler_now: A native comparison view can present supplied schedules and conditions without a model choosing the route.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain transfers, actual cargo suitability and security trade-offs not captured in standard fields.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a defensible route when advertised service facts and real shipment needs conflict.
tasks.altitude: The forwarder may prepare fewer comparison tables but retains route-selection responsibility.

reach.task: Explain a route choice with documented constraints
reach.learn: Schedule validity, transfers and security evidence

evidence.claim: A deterministic table of checked route alternatives is plausible; actual suitability judgement and local savings remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is route comparison and selection, excluding booking, sensitive-cargo instruction authoring and carrier negotiation. A roll-up assigns overlapping suitability work once.

The customer supplies existing cargo and delivery/security needs; carriers supply existing route offers before s1. The forwarder checks and captures goods needs, origin/destination, delivery window, candidate route/service IDs, legs, departure/arrival times and zones, cutoffs, transfers, offer validity and expressly stated restrictions in s1. All manual capture is counted.

S2 only displays checked alternatives and calculates explicit elapsed times; it does not infer missing leg connections, current capacity or a security rating. Unknown conditions remain unknown and require manual enquiry in the retained selection step.

Test native comparison views before custom code. Existing tables or automatic planning yield no new saving. Allow 6 focal hours per 100 baseline for view upkeep and schedule-mapping exceptions, plus 2 other-role hours for source interfaces.
unknowns: Carrier offer format and schedule reliability
research_questions: Does a native comparison view save preparation time without increasing mistaken connections or hiding unknown constraints?

already_counted.description: Requirement and candidate-route capture and checks remain counted
Suitability judgement and route choice remain fully counted

incremental.description: Maintain comparison fields and resolve schedule mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving 20 less 6 focal upkeep gives net 14. Range 1-8 assumes manual comparison preparation remains but transfer and security uncertainties still need full human review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Document generation and route-comparison preparation may take less time, while evidence checking, issue authority and route suitability remain with the forwarder.
reach: Prepare complete customs forms for authorised representatives
Explain route constraints to transport planners
role.ambitious_version: Use checked shipment data consistently across documents and route comparisons while preserving authorised decisions and visible exceptions.
